Publish.LongDescription:
# HydroDam Fix 1.6.2f1
Fixes the hydroelectric dam regression introduced in Cities: Skylines II 1.6.2f1.
## Fixes
- Hydroelectric dams incorrectly producing 0 MW - Incorrect -100% Low Water Level penalty despite sufficient water - New dam placement showing 0 W - Dam placement no longer orienting correctly with river flow
The mod applies a narrowly targeted compatibility fix to the affected water-flow CPU readback path.
It does not modify save-game data, the hydroelectric production formula, or the water simulation itself.
The fix is guarded: if the affected implementation is no longer present, the mod makes no change.
Source code is available on GitHub.
Publish.ChangeLog:
## 0.1.0
Initial release.
- Fixes hydroelectric dams producing 0 MW. - Fixes incorrect Low Water Level penalties. - Restores hydroelectric dam placement power estimates. - Restores river-flow-based dam orientation. - Adds compatibility guards so no change is made if the known regression is absent.
